name: Nantucket™ Window Shadings
description: Nantucket™ Window Shadings blend the softness of a sheer with the precise light control of a blind, creating a relaxed coastal-inspired elegance.

benefits.text:
UV Protection with View-Through
Nantucket shadings provide outdoor views while protecting flooring, furniture 
and décor from the sun’s harmful UV rays.
Concise Collection
Easily find your perfect Nantucket™ shading with a streamlined offering of 
beautiful and durable fabrics and colors.
Daytime Privacy
During the day, the rear sheer deflects light to the outside and obscures views 
from the street into your home.
Customizable Light Control
Fabric vanes tilt to achieve the preferred amount of illumination, whether 
it’s a well-lit space or a room with a softer brilliance. Choose from a range 
of operating systems that make it easy to control light.
Benefits of 
Nantucket™ shadings 
extend beyond 
gorgeous light 
diffusion that 
creates an inviting 
atmosphere.

operating systems.
Child Safety Labels on Corded Systems
These warning labels appear on window 
fashions with cords to make consumers aware
of window cord hazards for children and pets.  
EasyRise™
A continuous cord loop system raises and lowers 
the shading by simply pulling on the cord.
UltraGlide®
A single retractable wand for enhanced child 
safety. With one click, the fabric panel drops 
and the vanes open. Pump the wand to close 
the vanes or raise the shading.
SoftTouch® Motorization
A battery-operated, cordless system. Gently pull 
down on the wand to lower shadings, or lightly 
push up to raise them.
LiteRise®
Adjust shadings with a light touch on the 
handle. Pull down to lower; push up to raise.
    WARNING/
ADVERTENCIA

Strangulation Risk

or loose  tension device or 
retractable cord that fails to fully 
retract pose a strangulation risk 
to children. To avoid this potential strangula-

ucts or products with inaccessible cords.

OPERATING SYSTEMS
AND OPTIONS

Specialty Shapes
Nantucket™ shadings can accommodate shapes such as arches and angles. 
All specialty shapes are non-operable.
Tilt Only
Best for French doors or narrow windows, this option keeps the Nantucket™ 
shading lowered but allows vanes to tilt open and closed. Exclusively available 
with the EasyRise operating system.
Palette® Fabric-Covered Headrail
Upgrade to create a uniform look with a headrail wrapped in color-coordinated fabric. 
Two-On-One Headrail
For larger windows, two independently operated shadings can share the same 
headrail. Available with EasyRise™, LiteRise® and UltraGlide® operating systems. 
A Deux™
The dual roller system features a translucent shading in the front and a room-darkening 
panel in the back. Comes standard with Palette® Fabric-Covered Headrail.
Nantucket Fabric Parksley™    Color Element

Operating System PowerView® Automation     
Magnetic Hold-Down Brackets
Secure Nantucket shadings on French doors or sidelight applications with 
magnetic hold-down brackets. Can also be used on all other operating systems 
to prevent movement of the bottom rail in a window.
